catalogueDoc.summary: Datasette is a tool for exploring and publishing data. It turns SQLite databases into an interactive website and JSON API.

routes.title: Print a Datasette page's JSON straight in your terminal
routes.description: Installs Datasette and asks it for its own version information without starting a server, printing the JSON.

routes.title: Browse a sample database in the Datasette web interface
routes.description: Builds the repository's sample database and serves it as an explorable website on port 8001.

stepsSketch.cmd: python tests/fixtures.py fixtures.db fixtures-config.json fixtures-metadata.json plugins --extra-db-filename extra_database.db

routes.title: Run the test suite and watch it pass
routes.description: Installs the development dependencies and runs the automated tests, the parallel ones first and then the serial ones.

routes.title: Create a signed API token and see it printed
routes.description: Generates an API token for the root user with a chosen secret and prints it.

routes.title: List the plugins installed with Datasette
routes.description: Prints a JSON list of the plugins Datasette has loaded.

routes.title: Publish a database to Heroku or Google Cloud Run
routes.description: Deploys a SQLite database as a public website and API.

routes.title: Run Datasette behind an Apache proxy in a container

routes.title: Run the browser-based Playwright tests
routes.description: Runs the interface tests in a real browser.

routes.description: Runs the Prettier formatter check over the bundled JavaScript.
